mutants.why: The pushed coverage always runs to the window end instead of the intersection with the imported years, so a never-imported year is declared covered.
The window extends across a missing year instead of stopping at the first gap, so the gap year is declared covered.
A window whose start year was never imported is still pushed.
The pushed window starts 29 days back instead of 30, one day narrower than invoice's own window.
The pushed window ends 399 days ahead instead of 400.
A successful import no longer pushes the calendar to invoice-service.
A push failure fails the import although the data is already committed and owned by the monolith.
A failed import still triggers a push.
